name: Alpertine
summary: Alpertine is a drug of the pertine group described as an antipsychotic, neuroleptic, and tranqulizer which was never marketed.

pharmacology.text: The related drug oxypertine shows high affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2 and dopamine D2 receptors (Ki = 8.6 nM and 30 nM, respectively) and is also known to act as a catecholamine depleting agent. Oxypertine, milipertine, and solypertine all antagonize the behavioral effects of tryptamine, a serotonin receptor agonist, and apomorphine, a dopamine receptor agonist, in animals.

uses.text: Alpertine (INN, USAN; developmental code name WIN-31665) is a drug of the pertine group described as an antipsychotic, neuroleptic, and tranqulizer which was never marketed.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Antipsychotics that block dopamine receptors can cause stiffness, restlessness, tremor, sedation and weight gain.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。阻斷多巴胺受體的抗精神病藥可能造成肌肉僵硬、坐立不安、顫抖、鎮靜與體重增加。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。阻断多巴胺受体的抗精神病药可能造成肌肉僵硬、坐立不安、颤抖、镇静与体重增加。

fact.en: It belongs to the pertine family, alongside oxypertine. Its code name, WIN-31665, comes from the Sterling-Winthrop company, whose drugs carried the WIN prefix.
fact.zh: 它與 oxypertine 同屬 pertine 家族。它的代號 WIN-31665 來自 Sterling-Winthrop 公司，該公司的藥物都以 WIN 為字首。
fact.zhHans: 它与 oxypertine 同属 pertine 家族。它的代号 WIN-31665 来自 Sterling-Winthrop 公司，该公司的药物都以 WIN 为前缀。
